A '''skirmish in the Horuz system''' occurred in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] shortly after the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] destroyed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Despayre]] and left the [[Horuz system/Legends|Horuz system]].

==Background==
The [[Battle of Kalla VII|capture]] of the [[Frigate/Legends|Frigate]] [[Priam (starship)|''Priam'']] revealed that the construction site of the Death Star was located in the Horuz system near the prison planet Despayre. Two [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] collectively comprising ''[[Ethar]]'' was dispatched to the system to investigate, and found only the shattered remnants of the planet Despayre and no trace of the Death Star. However the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] forces left in the system in anticipation of the arrival of Rebel forces managed to capture the corvettes.<ref name="XWOSG" />

==The battle==
[[File:Skirmish_in_the_Horuz_system.jpg|thumb|left|250px|An X-wing is hit during the battle]]
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] was chosen to lead a team of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] supporting the rescue and recapture mission, with rookie [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Casal Marskan]] and [[Horodi]] as his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmen]]. Further Alliance forces arrived in the system shortly after. While the X-wings of Red Squadron engaged the Imperial [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|gunboats]], [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] disabled the corvettes. The two [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttles]] ''[[Rogue]]'' then arrived in the system and managed to recover the corvettes. ''Ethar 1'' and ''Ethar 2'' eventually entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and left the system, in Rebel hands once again. All of Red Squadron's X-wings were destroyed, although Captain Farlander was able to eject and be rescued.<ref name="Xwing" /><ref name="XWOSG" />

==Aftermath==
The data collected by the corvettes in the Horuz system revealed to the Rebels that the Death Star was completely operational and had left Despayre to another destination.<ref name="XWOSG" />
